title: NASA asteroid sheet: 101955 Bennu diameter 0.49 km, ~mass 0.000073×10^15 kg
summary: The sheet's selected-asteroid row for Bennu prints diameter 0.49 km and an approximate mass 0.000073 × 10^15 kg.
body: The Asteroid Fact Sheet row for 101955 Bennu prints diameter 0.49 km, mass about 0.000073 × 10^15 kg, rotation period 4.276 hrs, orbital period 1.20 yrs, spectral class , semi-major axis 1.126 AU, eccentricity 0.2037, and inclination 6.03 deg. Orbit values for epoch JD 2457400.5 (2016-01-13). Most of the values for mass and many of the diameter values are only rough estimates. The mass column header on the sheet is "~Mass", which marks the mass as approximate.  This card does not promote the row to a precision measurement.
